title: Library feed, version 1
description: The signed list of every element a library publishes (part D §4). Signed by the namespace key: this is the statement of which element versions legitimately exist, and a channel index may only select among them (S4). The core is closed (additionalProperties: false) so that no field can be added that carries a client identifier (S8) or names a resource for a client to fetch (S1); growth goes through 'extensions'. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

revision.description: Commit of the element repository the feed was generated from. Together with catalogueRevision this makes the feed reproducible.

catalogueRevision.description: Commit of the translation catalogues, or null when the names come from the .elmt files alone.

usage.description: Library-level usage declaration. REQUIRED, no default (annex §10.1.1).

contact_unreachable.description: Set by the host when delivery to the contributor's relay fails permanently. Removes nothing and changes no ranking.

path.description: Relative POSIX path inside the library, NFC-normalised, ending in .elmt. No leading slash, no '.' or '..' segment, no backslash. It identifies the element within the library; the blob is fetched by hash, never by path.

hash.description: sha256 of the element file; the blob is served at blob/<hex>.

size.description: Exact byte size of the blob. A client stops a transfer beyond it (annex §7.1, endless data).

names.description: Finished display names, one string per language. Plural categories and message formats are already evaluated by the generator; a client never evaluates a message format (annex §8.1).

nameProvenance.description: Human or machine translation, per language. A language absent here has unknown provenance.

domain.description: Engineering domain the element belongs to.

deviceKey.description: Groups the elements that are views of the same physical device (part D §13.3). Views sharing a deviceKey carry the same port identifiers and classes.

symbolStandard.description: Convention applied within a kind of view (part D §14.3), e.g. iec-60617.

articles.description: Flat list of the articles this drawing can represent. Deliberately no product attribute model (part D §5).

usage.description: Optional per-element override. An element without one inherits the library's; that is the normal case.

deprecated.description: ELEMENT lifecycle: the drawing is wrong or replaced. Says nothing about the product.

spec.description: Connection properties (part D §4): what the port accepts, not catalogue data. Every value carries a unit.

dict.description: Reference to a property dictionary (ETIM, IEC 61360 / ECLASS, VDI 3805). A reference, never a copy; never dereferenced by a client.

variant.description: Free-text label for humans, e.g. 'C16, 1P, 6 kA'.

provenance.description: How the element came to exist. A declaration by the publisher, never a verification by the host.

derived_from.description: <uuid>@<version> of the element this one was forked from.
